answer_1.quote: Dialogue evaluation plays a crucial role in the recent advancement of dialogue research.

answer_2.quote: automatic dialogue evaluation metrics draw growing attention as they can assess dialogues with faster speed and lower cost.

answer_4.quote: We collected human judgements from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: The crowd-workers are provided with the full multi-turn conversation for evaluation. We ask crowd-workers to evaluate the relevancy, avoiding contradiction, avoiding repetition, persona consistency and overall quality of the conversation.
